notes.title: Test Demo Build End and Development News
notes.notes:
Hello friends,

Thank you to everyone who played the combat test build. We appreciate it greatly. We have shared the many feedbacks you provided with all the developers, and after discussions, we plan to utilize them to make the game even more enjoyable by applying them in-game.

In the next demo build, we will ensure you can enjoy growth through leveling up and skills.

Additionally, we'd like to share a portion of the tutorial boss, one of the elements currently under development. We are preparing a more thrilling and exciting battle with the tutorial boss. You will be able to experience it in the next demo. Please wait just a little longer.

We are doing our best in development. Thank you always for your support!

notes.title: Battle Test Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/8bbd26bfa5331e37b8698b9b789d2ce17718a413.jpg[/img]

Hello friends!

I've quickly fixed the issues that occurred in this demo.

I'll share the fixed parts with you.

[b][Changes and Fixes][/b]

• Fixed the issue where characters would teleport during battle.

• Fixed the issue where, when running in some countries, the attack power of all characters would 
  abnormally increase, causing all characters to die in one hit.

• Fixed the issue where the player would not move when executing the counter and would then move 
  later.

• Fixed the issue where the player would not be able to move after entering a wall in some locations.

• Fixed the issue where the player would not be able to follow the monster due to an invisible wall.

• Reduced the volume of the sound of Dionia's footsteps.

Thank you so much for always supporting us!

We will do our best to develop a fun game!

notes.title: You can finally play the battle demo!
notes.notes:
Hello friends
Finally, you can play the combat test demo!
We've made it so you can enjoy it during this holiday season.

This game is a combat test demo of Velaster.
All skills have been acquired for the test, and some of the character's stats have been adjusted.
The demo ends when you defeat the final boss, <Garron the Corrupted Spear>.
*Because this is a combat test, some UI and systems may have malfunctions.

If you have any questions, please contact us on Discord and we will respond as soon as possible.

[url=https://discord.gg/38vWUd9fES]Discord[/url]

notes.title: We'll be releasing a combat test demo next week.
notes.notes:
Hello. Friends
It seems that the battle demo that was supposed to be released today will have to be postponed to next week.
I'm really sorry.

We originally planned to release a 30-minute version of the battle demo.
However, all the team members thought that the main reason for making an indie game is to test it with users rather than just testing it in a small office.
That's why we decided to release a version that's over an hour long if you play through the underground dungeon area and the boss.
There were some sudden changes, so we wanted to show it to those who have been waiting for our game without any bugs.

Once again, we apologize for the delay.

I'll explain the additional parts.
A parry that wasn't in the previous version has been added. And if you successfully parry and input the attack key at high speed, you can use the counterattack right away.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/6acf40f2955cfd51ceeb03c9a6736c7da811a167.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/c83eb50213820fcbecf8a107c46221e9e3c8ec1b.jpg[/img]


This is the underground dungeon area. If you explore all the areas that have been revealed and play until the final boss fight, you can play for over an hour.

This weekend, I will use all my time except for sleeping to release the combat test demo. Please wait a little. You will definitely see us next week.

Thank you always. Your support has been a great motivation for us to develop!

notes.title: Big news! The combat test demo is coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
We have some big news today.
We're releasing a combat test demo this holiday season!
We'll be releasing it sometime this Friday.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/32c5e07606151aa674c89e752cabcafc99c59caa.jpg[/img]

< 3D exploration possible >

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/b22b14caef8b30851ca4fdf0a2c790152c95dfde.jpg[/img]

<Battle with a new boss>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/93425640ea0e5879ae8fe313dd461074e494350a.jpg[/img]

< Various trap areas >

The reason we decided to suddenly release the combat test demo on Steam is because we realized that just talking among ourselves in the office and developing is not very meaningful.

I think listening to the opinions of users and developing together is the way for a small indie company like us to develop a game.

Starting with this demo, we will continue to develop VELASTER together with users by updating and sharing.

It's not a perfect version yet. It's a combat-oriented test version.
It's a slightly longer version than the version tested at Tokyo Game Show and other game shows.
Enjoy it at your own pace.

I hope you enjoy it at home this holiday season.
If you have any other questions, come to our Discord and talk to us.

Wishing you all the best!

notes.title: Hello. Friends, spring has already come.
notes.notes:
Hello. friends
How is everyone? Spring has already come. Last winter was a very cold and difficult winter.
There have been many trials, but we have overcome them well and are working hard to develop.

For a small indie game company like us, we share posts because we think it's good to share even small things with users.

What we are sharing this time is the addition of a new boss map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/4c36442e35a810d6d36cc079a45c79739696a197.png[/img]

This is a boss map prepared to force players and the boss into a narrow space and engage in exciting battles. In a space where you can't escape, you have to quickly figure out the boss' pattern to survive! If you fail, you will fall into the traps installed on both sides and die.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/64a766e328170f51aa3300af2da5745938a82a36.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/82def00d4393202f5f10e906d0a824f5db41f579.png[/img]

In addition, we are in the process of creating various boss maps.

We are always grateful to our users who always support us.
We are working hard to produce without giving up. Please continue to support us in the future.

I've been stuck in the office these days, but it feels like spring has arrived, so I'm sharing a photo of cherry blossoms I took while taking a walk outside with my colleagues. Life always seems to be a series of hardships. Look at the beautiful flower photos and I hope that all your wishes come true.
  be happy. We will also try to share interesting news.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/253ee66b470f39ee4e39de9586498bb3c8e19d6d.png[/img]

notes.title: Development Log – Monster Encyclopedia Chapter 1 – Zombies
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/a6319dd8c32e740231962a601a19d7309f06ef2d.png[/img]

Hello. friends
How are you doing during this cold winter?
The end-of-year gift we prepared is the story of Velaster’s ‘Monster Encyclopedia Chapter 1-Zombies.’
There are many different types of monsters in Velaster.
Among them, zombies are the lowest level monsters.
There are three main types of zombies.
The weakest zombie monsters are ‘Abandoned Ones’.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/3c844bdeaf727ebc6051443caeb95ac648953747.png[/img]

‘Abandoned Ones’ are the weakest humans attacked by other monsters when chaos surges and Malum collapses.
Humans who are dead or whose bodies are damaged are contaminated by chaos and have become zombies.
They are unintelligent and attack anything that moves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/099a472fd9576ce002587b7f36bcaacab4445bb5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/ec59cef0d95411798da2405ca0d17f65218691f4.gif[/img]

Those left behind...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/88442e10587214e5af46f183f16b1a4851259f9a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/b39de477c5167861ac0d6ce6076730a82e70d09b.png[/img]

The ‘those left behind’ escape the chaos and take refuge in a village in the valley, receiving the protection of Vargos.
Although he was alive, Vargos was gradually losing his strength and chaos slowly began to creep in without his knowledge.
We were becoming zombies. Those who noticed it were the most sacred things they had.
He carried objects on his body, but as he slowly became contaminated with chaos, he began to carry those objects on his body.
I started stabbing. Now, with the cross stuck to his body, he attacks everything that passes by.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/99e7fcfdceec2bf589c62c67e9d68aa197dc23f4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/6394595c8e5c9d5effa235dd4884a9ec82e7c5f3.gif[/img]

A being gone crazy
The fastest and most agile of Velaster's zombies
She has very little rationality and all of her physical abilities are superior to those of other zombies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/00d256b9b1ce488df9560b6cea30f1b761dbb47d.png[/img]

When two or more of them are nearby, you must decide your battle carefully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/c3a4399912093ba580ff7fc3f1d4613754d39813.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/d253966f6b15cc9c347ba402f433e540cc5f1c93.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/085d6ac6235f1f1e402c929959f4444c7cf3aa6c.gif[/img]

There are various monsters in Velaster.
If you play and catch monsters, you can use the monster encyclopedia in the game.
You will be able to get more information.

We are doing our best to develop it so that you can have fun adventures.
If you wishlist us on Steam, it will be a great motivation for our development.

I hope that this cold winter brings happy and warm energy with you.
We will continue to share various information in the future.
thank you

notes.title: Dev Blog / Sword and shield design renewal work
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/64f023e5f9da9d3f6f549a62554a1cf4a0e38d8a.png[/img]

Hello.
How are you all?
This is Jin, who is in charge of art at Velaster.
The five of us are still working hard to make Velaster a fun game.
In this development diary, I would like to share a part of the sword and shield renewal work that I have been thinking about for a long time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/cbbc774cf888880dd6de2642f68c29dfa39bd93b.png[/img]
 - Sword and shield design before renewal -

When designing the existing sword and shield, it was in the early stages of Velaster's development, so the overall design direction of the game was not yet clear.
So, the existing sword and shield design feels lacking in confidence and the concept is ambiguous.
I wanted to fix that.
I wanted to revise the design to speak more clearly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/6e1e667c925b04460d22c83825376951a71adeaa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/0118f809e6a18fafdec60338b13c42feeff3d269.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/0e845a8d697add6038fcf899af45e3fcefbdf727.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/a1be75a340009c3bd4feab7828f9f7610846ed7a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/90c4881e245f738fca50496b603fd6e820e6f682.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/ab7815006c547802dfc6d2930ccae40bf4d6f184.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/78fb7dbf018a59f45445944f8881a49a29288fbc.png[/img]


Also, what was important during the renewal process was 'the unique feel of the existing design must be retained to some extent.'
This was the most difficult part.
Since I am in charge of all the art by myself, I couldn't spend too much time on this part.
There is so much to do, including other UI, monster design, background design, and NPC design.
When it took too much time, we had no choice but to make some compromises.
Still, it seems to have been completed in a way that fits the concept.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/c66421ca2f4038ed87b45b5adf40a6759e6268d0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/c66421ca2f4038ed87b45b5adf40a6759e6268d0.png[/img]

We are currently making other equipment and weapons. Please look forward to developing fun and unique equipment and weapons.
If you have any comments about the game, please let us know. Your opinion is very valuable to a small indie company like us.
Although it may be slow, we will do our best to develop Velaster.
Please stay tuned.
I hope you are always happy.

notes.title: Patch Notes [ v0.0.2 ] - 2022.10.18 - Controller Now Support
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933078/6c41c984fb2ec95b2cc0f6fee20351eb8787e925.png[/img]

[b]2022.10.18 Patch Note[/b]

[b]*System[/b]
- Controller Now Support ! Check Keys in [ Option ] - [ Controller ]
- Added [ Keyboard ] [ Controller ] Tab in [ Option ]
- Changed English font size of Tutorial popup more larger
- Added ability to automatically hang on ledge. You can set it in [ Option ] - [ GamePlay ]
       - Manual : Press the Up Arrow Key to hang on ledge
       - Auto : Automatically hang on ledge in mid-air

[b]*Map[/b]
- Adjusted the number of wooden planks in the Village of the Forsaken
- Adjusted the lights of the Village of the Forsaken
- Removed Destructible Wall to avoid confusion in moving to the next route after killing the butcher
- Added a tutorial popup to be displayed near the destructible woodne floor so that player do not get confused in moving to the next route after killing the butcher
- After killing the butcher, elevator at the bottom can be used from below when working from above

[b]*Character[/b]
- Added slow walking motion for knight

[b]*Monster[/b]
- Adjusted the attack hitbox of monsters
- Adjusted the sound volume of some monsters
- Spawn locations of some monsters have been changed
- Camera vibration values of some monsters have been changed
- HP, Groggy HP values of some bosses have been changed

[b]*Bug Fix[/b]
- Fixed a bug where the last saved point would not respawn player when respawning or restarting
- Fixed a bug which can walk through the door of butchery without interaction
- Fixed a bug where the right death trap in the Skull Crawler boss room did not work
- Fixed an issue that caused player to exit the boss room after being attacked by the Prisoner of Tenebris
- After unlockiing the gate of ruins, unlock dialog is no longer displayed.
- Fixed a bug which water sound not playing when walking on water.
